dispositions.topic_text: Whether INV-10 tests must explicitly cover repeated JSON member names and at which object levels
dispositions.what: The INV-10 check covers a member name repeated in the top object, in objects and in a ConnectionEntry, each answering folder_unavailable before any project is looked up.

dispositions.topic_text: Whether INV-02 tests must cover every listed path-segment and metadata failure case
dispositions.what: The INV-02 check covers every failure of A3 rule 5 condition 1: each name form, a missing folder, a folder that is a link or not a folder, a missing or non-regular last segment and a failed metadata reading.

dispositions.topic_text: Whether INV-02 must prove that an ignored folder segment itself was never opened
dispositions.what: The INV-02 trace shows that an ignored segment, a folder or the file, is itself never opened.
